results.title: The Impact of Humic Acid Fertilizers on Crop Yield and Nitrogen Use Efficiency: A Meta-Analysis
results.abstract_notes: Meta-analysis of 93 articles, 383 yield observations. +12% yield increase, +27% NUE, +17% N uptake. Optimal application 100-200 kg/ha.

results.title: Effect of humic acid and fulvic acid based liquid and foliar fertilizers on the yield of wheat crop
results.abstract_notes: Liquid and foliar fertilizers containing humic/fulvic acids applied to wheat. Measures biological yield, grain production, economic efficiency.

results.title: Straw returning combined with controlled-release nitrogen fertilizer affected organic carbon storage and crop yield by changing humic acid composition and aggregate distribution
results.abstract_notes: Straw incorporation + N fertilizer trial. Humic acid is a measured soil quality indicator, NOT the applied treatment. No HA application vs control comparison.

results.title: Possibility of increasing early crop potato yield with foliar application of seaweed extracts and humic acids
results.first_author_institution: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
results.abstract_notes: Foliar HA applied to potato. Tests seaweed + HA combination. Measures tuber yield. Potential confound: humic acid not isolated from seaweed extract (co-application). Needs full text to confirm if HA-only arm exists.

results.title: The Application of Humic Acid Urea Improves Nitrogen Use Efficiency and Crop Yield by Reducing the Nitrogen Loss Compared with Urea
results.abstract_notes: Field trial comparing humic acid-modified urea vs plain urea. HA effect on crop yield measured with control arm. Good candidate.

results.title: Use of coal derived humic acid as soil conditioner for soil physical properties and its impact on wheat crop yield
results.abstract_notes: Coal-derived humic acid applied to wheat. Measures soil physical properties and wheat yield. Potential HA-only vs control comparison.

results.title: Humic Acid Fertilizer Improved Soil Properties and Soil Microbial Diversity of Continuous Cropping Peanut: A Three-Year Experiment
results.abstract_notes: 3-year field trial with HA fertilizer on peanut. Likely reports peanut yield alongside soil/microbial data. High citation count, Scientific Reports.

results.title: The role of biostimulants and bioeffectors as alleviators of abiotic stress in crop plants
results.journal: Chemical and Biological Technologies in Agriculture
results.abstract_notes: Broad review of biostimulants (including HA) under abiotic stress. Not a primary experiment. No original yield data.

results.title: Plant Biostimulants: Importance of the Quality and Yield of Horticultural Crops and the Improvement of Plant Tolerance to Abiotic Stress - A Review
results.first_author_institution: Institute of Agrophysics, Polish Academy of Sciences
results.abstract_notes: Review paper on biostimulants including HA. No primary yield data. Excluded as review.

results.title: Understanding the Role of Humic Acids on Crop Performance and Soil Health
results.abstract_notes: Review article synthesizing HA mechanisms and effects. No primary yield data reported. Excluded as review.

results.title: Synergistic Biostimulatory Action: Designing the Next Generation of Plant Biostimulants for Sustainable Agriculture
results.abstract_notes: Review/perspective on biostimulant synergies. HA mentioned as one of many biostimulants. No primary yield data.

results.title: Response of integrated use of humic acid and chemical fertilizer on growth and yield of rice crop (Oryza sativa L.) in calcareous soil
results.abstract_notes: HA + chemical fertilizer vs control on rice yield in calcareous soil. HA is the experimental variable. Good candidate.

results.title: Effect of foliar application of N and humic acids on growth and yield of durum wheat
results.abstract_notes: Foliar HA + N applied to durum wheat. HA tested alongside N, may or may not have HA-only arm to isolate effect. Needs full text. Wheat yield reported.

results.title: Amelioration of Al toxicity and P deficiency in acid soils by additions of organic residues: a critical review of the phenomenon and the mechanisms involved
results.abstract_notes: Review on organic residues for soil Al/P problems. Not a humic acid application trial. Not relevant.

results.title: Nitrogen-bonded aromatics in soil organic matter and their implications for a yield decline in intensive rice cropping
results.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
results.abstract_notes: NMR characterization of soil organic matter (humic substances) and yield decline mechanisms. Mechanistic study, no HA application treatment.

results.title: Sulfur-enriched leonardite and humic acid soil amendments enhance tolerance to drought and phosphorus deficiency stress in maize (Zea mays L.)
results.abstract_notes: HA (from leonardite) applied to maize under drought/P-deficiency stress. May report maize yield. HA is isolated treatment variable. Drought/stress context but crop yield should be reported.

results.title: The Recent Situation for Manufacturing Urea Humic Acid and Mechanesm in Incriasing Crop Yield
results.abstract_notes: Chinese-language journal (Soil Bulletin). Likely review/overview of urea-HA manufacturing. No DOI. Language may be Chinese despite EN tag. No primary yield data likely.

results.title: The Integration of Bio and Organic Fertilizers Improve Plant Growth, Grain Yield, Quality and Metabolism of Hybrid Maize (Zea mays L.)
results.abstract_notes: Bio + organic fertilizer integration in maize. Humic acid may or may not be an isolated experimental variable - title suggests multiple fertilizer combinations. Grain yield is reported.
